_purpose: Machine-readable list of producer-consumer relationships between current-state files, protocols, engines, schemas, docs, and AI loaders. Part of Hs Change Control v1.0 (INV-063 STAGED).
_authority: Identified failure mode: live AI-facing files disagreed on engine versions, CNQ shipped status, and investigation count. This registry makes those producer-consumer relationships explicit so future drift is detected by the consistency checker.
_pattern_source: NASA SP-2007-6105 (Systems Engineering Handbook) interface management: identify producers and consumers, name controlled fields, define failure modes, attach verification.

interfaces.name: Fast Refresh to AI Discovery Files
failure_modes: AI summary reports stale engine version
AI claims cnq.py is pending or missing despite shipped state
README claim contradicts llms.txt claim on same fact

interfaces.name: Engine Schema to CCTT Protocol
interfaces.producer: CNT and CNQ engine current state (CI-011, CI-012)
failure_modes: CCTT instructs users to expect old schema
CCTT describes shipped CNQ engine as future work
AI session stops because current output appears mismatched to legacy protocol
User runs current engine against old protocol and gets confused
interfaces.verification: CCTT files either match current engine state or explicitly declare legacy status

interfaces.name: Claim Strength to Public Language
failure_modes: Candidate claim stated as confirmed in public docs
D=3 described as native quaternion proof when it is a boundary embed
Universal claim overstated across all compositional data
interfaces.verification: Stale-phrase scan + manual claim review for S5 packets

interfaces.name: Terminology to Dependent Docs
failure_modes: Deprecated terminology returns in new docs
Mathematical object conflation (rank confused with order)

interfaces.name: Expected Results to Reproduction Docs
failure_modes: Verifier gates described stronger than they are
Hash observations confused with enforced expectations
interfaces.verification: Expected-results field comparison + explicit note that some hash observations are non-gating

usage_notes.when_to_add_interface: Add a new interface entry when a new file becomes a producer or consumer of currently-controlled fields, or when a new controlled field crosses file boundaries.
usage_notes.when_to_modify_interface: Modify when controlled fields change, consumer set changes, or failure modes are observed in practice. Modification requires a Discovery Change Packet of severity S3 or higher.
usage_notes.consistency_checker_contract: The consistency checker scripts/check_ai_refresh_consistency.py enforces the verification clause of each interface listed here. Adding an interface without adding a corresponding check is a known gap that should be flagged in the next change packet.
